commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tom Louchet (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+6' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
90+5' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
90+3' Kenny Lala (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90' The game is interrupted now, Kamory Doumbia (Brest) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Kevin (Nice) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
88' Yellow card. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) comes onto the pitch for Romain Del Castillo.
84' The ball is cleared after Kail Boudache (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
82' Claude Puel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isak Jansson (Nice) replacing Sofiane Diop.
82' Elye Wahi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
81' Elye Wahi (Nice) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
80' The resulting corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared.

79' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ludovic Ajorque (Brest), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Brest.
79' Joris Chotard (Brest) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

78' Kail Boudache (Nice) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Gregoire Coudert.
75' Joris Chotard (Brest) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
74' Here comes a substitution. Michel Diaz Jr. (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Soumaila Coulibaly.
73' Substitution. Charles Vanhoutte did his best and is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
72' 2 - 2 Elye Wahi (Nice) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
70' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Remy Labeau Lascary is replaced by Pathe Mboup (Brest).
70' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
68' The referee has issued a yellow card to Charles Vanhoutte (Nice).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kevin.
66' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
65' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

63' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jonathan Clauss flights the free kick into the box, where Ali Abdi (Nice) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom left corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:2.
60' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
58' A yellow card is awarded to Kojo Peprah (Nice).
55' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.

54' Joris Chotard (Brest) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom left corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
54' Brest take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
49' Daouda Guindo (Brest) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
46' Claude Puel has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kail Boudache comes on the pitch for Salis Abdul Samed (Nice).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' A cross into the box from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared.
44' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) gets a yellow card.
43' Ali Abdi (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregoire Coudert intercepts the ball.
42' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
41' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

41' Chance! Elye Wahi (Nice) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Gregoire Coudert is alert and makes a great save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
38' Sofiane Diop (Nice) sends the corner into the box, but Gregoire Coudert intercepts it and averts the threat.
38' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Now Nice have a corner.
37' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
37' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
36' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
36' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Elye Wahi (Nice) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
32' A pass by Ali Abdi (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
31' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
30' Morgan Sanson (Nice) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It's a throw-in for Nice.
29' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
27' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is intercepted by the defence.

26' Sofiane Diop (Nice) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Gregoire Coudert is equal to it and makes an easy save. Nice force their opponents to concede a corner.
26' A raking crossfield pass from Dante (Nice) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
23' 0 - 2 Goal! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes a short pass from Ludovic Ajorque in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 0:2.
22' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Kenny Lala (Brest) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
18' Daouda Guindo (Brest) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
17' Sofiane Diop (Nice) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Maxime Dupe into the bottom right corner.
15' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to take the penalty!
14' The referee shows a yellow card to Salis Abdul Samed (Nice). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.

13' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Dante (Nice). The referee gives a penalty to Brest after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
11' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

10' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Elye Wahi (Nice) meets a cross inside the box, but Gregoire Coudert wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
9' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
3' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
2' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Brest will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stephanie Frappart.
